<documents>
<document id="card-mobile-wallets">
UsingˆmobileˆwalletsˆYouˆcanˆaddˆyourˆTallowbrookˆphysicalˆorˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆtheˆmobileˆwalletˆonˆyourˆphoneˆorˆwatchˆandˆpayˆbyˆtappingˆatˆcheckout.ˆ##ˆAddˆaˆcardˆInˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp,ˆtapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆandˆtapˆAddˆtoˆwallet.ˆTheˆappˆsendsˆtheˆcardˆdetailsˆstraightˆtoˆyourˆwallet,ˆsoˆyouˆdon'tˆhaveˆtoˆtypeˆthem.ˆ##ˆThingsˆtoˆknowˆ-ˆYourˆwalletˆusesˆaˆdevice-specificˆnumberˆinsteadˆofˆyourˆcardˆnumber.ˆMerchantsˆneverˆseeˆyourˆrealˆcardˆnumber.ˆ-ˆFreezingˆaˆcardˆinˆtheˆappˆalsoˆblocksˆwalletˆpaymentsˆonˆthatˆcard.ˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆreportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆremoveˆitˆfromˆyourˆwalletˆandˆaddˆtheˆreplacementˆonceˆit'sˆactivated.ˆAˆvirtualˆcardˆcanˆbeˆaddedˆrightˆaway.ˆ-ˆLimits,ˆfeesˆandˆCushionˆworkˆtheˆsameˆwayˆforˆwalletˆpaymentsˆasˆforˆcardˆpayments.ˆ##ˆIfˆaddingˆfailsˆMakeˆsureˆtheˆcardˆisˆactivatedˆandˆnotˆfrozen,ˆandˆthatˆyourˆphoneˆhasˆaˆscreenˆlockˆset.ˆWalletsˆwon'tˆaddˆaˆcardˆonˆaˆdeviceˆwithoutˆaˆscreenˆlock.ˆIfˆyou'veˆlostˆyourˆphone,ˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆfromˆanotherˆdeviceˆbyˆsigningˆinˆtoˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆmessageˆsupport.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-replacement-basic">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆOnˆBasic,ˆifˆyouˆchooseˆexpeditedˆshippingˆyouˆpayˆbothˆtheˆreplacementˆfeeˆandˆtheˆshippingˆfee.ˆStandardˆshippingˆonlyˆcostsˆtheˆreplacementˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-freeze">
FreezingˆandˆunfreezingˆyourˆcardˆFreezingˆyourˆcardˆblocksˆnewˆpurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆstraightˆaway.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆthingˆtoˆdoˆifˆyou'veˆmisplacedˆyourˆcardˆandˆthinkˆyouˆmightˆfindˆitˆagain.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆSwitchˆitˆoffˆtoˆunfreeze.ˆBothˆhappenˆinstantly,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆdoˆitˆasˆoftenˆasˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstillˆworksˆwhileˆfrozenˆ-ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆtoˆmerchantsˆyou'veˆalreadyˆauthorized,ˆsuchˆasˆsubscriptionsˆ-ˆRefundsˆfromˆmerchantsˆ-ˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆ-ˆYourˆvirtualˆcard,ˆwhichˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitchˆ##ˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆlost?ˆIfˆyou'reˆsureˆtheˆcardˆisˆgoneˆorˆstolen,ˆreportˆitˆlostˆorˆstolenˆinstead.ˆThatˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanentlyˆandˆletsˆyouˆorderˆaˆreplacement.ˆAˆfreezeˆisˆtemporaryˆandˆreversible.ˆ##ˆFreezeˆversusˆfraudˆlockˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook,ˆthat'sˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆnotˆaˆfreeze.ˆYouˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlockˆwithˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆSeeˆ"WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?".ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆforˆyouˆifˆyouˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Am I on the hook if someone uses my stolen card?
